description: Extract the readable text of a web page as clean markdown. Fetches one public http(s) HTML page and returns its main content as markdown, plus title, meta description, byline and a short excerpt, with menus and page clutter removed. Useful for summarizing, quoting, or feeding a page to an LLM or RAG index without a browser. Not for logged-in, paywalled or non-HTML URLs (such as PDFs); private hosts are refused. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402 on Base) or 1 prepaid pack credit. Failed calls aren't charged when you pay per call with x402: if the job errors, the USDC payment is never settled. With pack credits (X-Entitlement-Key), a call that fails gives its credit back.
name: page_extract
